body:
## Outcome
After the finite native UX route **#5994**, make commonly expected interactive controls reusable as **checked Conduit presentation component Plots/Fores** over the one Face/Mask/Show interlock, with truthful realizations on browser, native ConduitOS, and deterministic linear/terminal Masks. This is a **follow-on**, not a new prerequisite or a 16th step of #5994. Coordinate browser realization with #5376 (real selected Web Component Backs), portable component contracts #5365/#5378, verified correspondence #5372, accessibility #5367, native #5357, and Looks #5366/#5379.

**Architectural law:** source Plot/Body owns actual values, memberships, availability, validation, commits, revisions and effects; Face projects their human-meaningful relationships and typed actions; a checked component Fore/structural recipe consumes that semantic projection; a selected browser/native/linear Back produces an accessible bounded Show; fresh, exact Show/revision/target/argument-bound `FaceInteraction` returns through ordinary execution. A Mask may retain focus, view scroll, popup position, provisional editor/IME input and uncommitted query drafts locally. It never owns the selected domain value, fabricates options, grants actions, or creates a second application state machine.

## Existing implementations to **reuse rather than clone**
- `semantics/face/src/{semantics.rs,readable_choices.rs}`: action arguments have complete checked value contracts; limited canonical finite choice membership can already be presented without altering the contract; Face has Collection/Item/TextEntry subjects and Contains relations.
- `semantics/face/src/application_view.rs` and `semantics/face/types.conduit`: migration-era `ApplicationComponent` includes text input, textarea, select, option, choice groups, table, grid and related pieces. This is evidence to **migrate**, not justification for a second stable widget ontology.
- `targets/browser/handbook/owner-face-component.mjs`, `proof/browser/face-nucleus.spec.mjs`: current browser already uses native `input`, `select`, radio controls, finite action membership, drafts and composition handling, plus adversarial forged-option tests. Do not discard or duplicate their verified binding protections.
- `input/saved-choice` with stable option ID/label pairs; `face/editor` + `text/document@1`/`text/edit@1` in `docs/input-semantics.md`; and the current native scene input drafts / source-owned reversible Boolean checkboxes (#5989/#6031).
- `docs/architecture/face-grammar-conformance.md`: Face is a human-semantic waist, **not a universal widget tree**.

## The control families to prove
1. **Lists / collections**: distinguish informational repeated items, navigable item collections, and **selectable** listboxes. Selection is permitted only when the source actually offers a checked action. Preserve item identity independently from display text; grouping, ordering, count, empty/loading/refusal, disabled items, focus vs selected, bounded pagination/continuation and screen-free traversal. Filtering is Mask-local only when it does not claim changed authoritative membership; source query/filter operations need explicit typed action/Flow.
2. **Choice inputs**: source-owned exclusive, independently reversible or legitimately multiple selections with explicit membership, cardinality and current value; `select`, radio/checklist and listbox are alternative renderings, **not different source semantics**. One-way actions must not masquerade as toggle checkboxes. No option identity by index or label alone.
3. **Text fields**: bounded single-line name/search and multiline editing, existing `FaceActionArgument` for atomic entered values and existing revisioned `face/editor` for document replacement. Separate transient local drafts, pending submit, committed source values, validation/error/help/required/readonly/refused state. Preserve exact UTF-8, Unicode scalar ranges and source revision; explicitly declare grapheme-navigation and IME capabilities per Host, avoiding unsupported native parity claims. No automatic Body commit on every keystroke without an authored contract.
4. **Comboboxes**: distinguish select-only from editable with suggestions, and within editable distinguish **fixed-membership** from **free-text-authorized** input. Typed text, popup navigation, highlight, selected option and committed value are distinct. Suggestion queries may be local over bounded admitted options or separately source-backed, but may not silently change source state. Reuse list + text contracts; no new mandatory domain Combobox Kind.
5. **Later extension points**: checked numeric/Quantity entries, toggles/radios, search/filter, error summaries, steps/progress, tables/grids and hierarchical collections when an actual specimen demands them. Do not attempt a full GUI toolkit in this track.

## Execution and proof shape
Four **small independently reviewable** tracks, linked below when created:
- C1: finite collection, choice and listbox selection source/Face/Fore contract and one real specimen.
- C2: text input and editable combobox composition, source validation and local-only drafts.
- W4: actual selected browser Web Component Back using trusted native controls + fallback, after #5376 W1/W2 foundation; real Chromium and accessibility proof (WAI APG combobox/listbox behavior where applicable).
- N4: bounded native ConduitOS rendering and keyboard/pointer acceptance of the **same** source specimen (plus linear fallback), after #5994's native acceptance.

A reusable **Crèche** or **Todo** source specimen is preferred; do not duplicate #5991's already-owned single Body-name control or redo #5989's checkbox foundation. One accepted source/Face must be encountered with the same subject/action/argument meaning through selected browser Web Component, browser generic fallback, real QEMU native and linear/screen-free alternative; inspect exact Show/Plan/Play/Host/Boot identities and refusal reasons. Include no selection, missing/stale option, multiple-label collisions, unexpected Unicode, long/empty text, IME draft, unsupported Back, lost input/focus, disabled/read-only, no-room-for-popup, deep list/pagination, forged DOM/Shadow action, stale Show, and replacement while focused. Every rejected domain action has zero committed mutation; fallback does not claim unsupported interaction richness.

Keep #5994's **01–15** serial queue unchanged and honor #5520 WIP-two / one-active-native-scene implementation rule. Do not require ConduitOS to parse HTML/CSS/ARIA or execute browser JavaScript. A registered custom element is one **optional browser Back**, not the semantic component itself. Browser accessibility lowering is trusted, not supplied as arbitrary custom-element authority.

## Completion
- [ ] Portable semantics/source contracts accepted without a new Face widget hierarchy.
- [ ] Actual browser generic and selected Web Component controls reproduce same checked source action/value with keyboard, pointer, focus, labels and fallback.
- [ ] Actual QEMU and deterministic-linear specimen honestly preserve all reachable values/actions and explicit limitations.
- [ ] Exact-source Candidate/Integration and bounded resource/latency receipts for each changed Host; no unmeasured cold-start/real-time claims.


---

## Linked four-slice follow-on queue

- [ ] **C1 #6039**: [Bounded Collection/Item lists and source-owned single/multi-choice selection](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/issues/6039). This establishes stable item IDs/membership and tested Fore correspondence without a new widget Kind.
- [ ] **C2 #6040**: [Atomic text arguments, revisioned editor reuse and editable suggestions](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/issues/6040). Build combobox on checked list+text semantics, not on local DOM state.
- [ ] **W4 #6041**: [Selected actual browser Web Component Back and generic fallback](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/issues/6041), after #5376 W1/W2 foundations. This is a **browser-only realization**.
- [ ] **N4 #6042**: [Actual QEMU native list, choices and text interaction plus linear conformance](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/issues/6042), after #5994's current finite sequence is accepted.

These are **sequential dependency/coordination slots**, not four simultaneous PRs. The portable semantic proof can proceed while native #5994 runs if file ownership remains separate; WIP-two #5520 applies. An already-satisfied source/Host behavior is evidenced and reused, not reimplemented.
title: [Mask Controls · Follow-on] Portable lists, choices, text entry and comboboxes across Masks
